title: Mad Libs
mechanic: Finding and replacing with regular expressions

scenario.title: A template engine meets real answers
scenario.body: "Hi <first name>, your <item> has shipped" is a Mad Lib with real customers. The book drops each answer into re.sub, so a backslash someone types gets eaten, and a blank called <noun (plural)> is never found. It also treats "5 < 6 and 7 > 3" as a blank, and quietly keeps going when an answer is missing or extra. A half-filled email must never go out.

try_args: inputs/help.txt -i Hey tacos Oi salsa Hola queso Arriba

character.name: Mabel
character.role: a llama who tells silly stories

tagline: Mabel has a story with holes in it. Fill each hole with any word you like, then hear what she makes of it.

brain_blurbs.book: Finds each <hole> and swaps your word in with a find-and-replace.
brain_blurbs.real: Puts your words in exactly as typed, and stops if a word is missing.

rules.test_usage: Explains the game when you ask for help
rules.test_bad_file: Says so when the story file doesn't exist
rules.test_no_blanks: A story with no holes? She tells you, and stops
rules.test_fox: Fills the fox story: "The quick surly car jumps under the lazy bicycle."
rules.test_help: Fills the same kind of hole many times, in order
rules.test_verona: Fills all ten holes in Romeo and Juliet ("stick shift" counts as one word!)
rules.test_backslashes_are_kept: Words with a \ in them go in exactly as typed
rules.test_odd_blank_names_work: Holes with brackets or + in their name still get filled
rules.test_maths_is_not_a_blank: "5 < 6 and 7 > 3" is maths, not a hole
rules.test_too_few_answers_is_an_error: Not enough words? She stops instead of telling half a story
rules.test_too_many_answers_is_an_error: Too many words? She says so instead of losing one
rules.test_same_blank_twice_gets_two_answers: Two <noun> holes get two different words
rules.test_story_from_stdin: Can read the story you type, not just a file
rules.test_asks_at_the_keyboard: With no words given, she asks for each one: "Give me an adjective"
rules.test_running_out_of_answers_at_the_keybo: If you stop typing early, she says which word is missing
